text.ms:
1. (1) Perintah ini bolehlah dinamakan Perintah Jalan Persekutuan

(Lebuh Raya Pesisiran Pantai Barat (Taiping-Banting)) (Pindaan) 2019.

(2) Perintah ini mula berkuat kuasa pada 23 September 2019.

Pindaan perenggan 2

2. Perintah Jalan Persekutuan (Lebuh Raya Pesisiran Pantai Barat

(Taiping-Banting)) 2019 [P.U. (A) 150/2019], yang disebut "Perintah ibu" dalam Perintah

ini, dipinda dalam perenggan 2—

(a) Dengan menggantikan subperenggan (1) dengan subperenggan

yang berikut:

"(1) Bahagian jalan yang berikut diisytiharkan sebagai

jalan Persekutuan:

(a) bahagian jalan yang dikenali sebagai Lebuh Raya Pesisiran

Pantai Barat (Taiping–Banting) yang bermula dari

kilometer 143.99 di koordinat U 421777.709,

T 333667.462Grid Bentuk Benar Serong di Tepi (RSO)

Geosentrik (GDM 2000) dan berakhir di kilometer 162.07

di koordinat U 438818.638, T 331585.659Grid RSO

Geosentrik (GDM 2000) (kedua-dua jarak diukur dari

kilometer 0.0 Lebuh Raya Pesisiran Pantai Barat

(Taiping–Banting) di Persimpangan Bertingkat Banting)

termasuk Persimpangan Bertingkat Hutan Melintang,

Plaza Tol Masuk/Keluar Hutan Melintang, Plaza Tol

Masuk/Keluar Teluk Intan, Persimpangan Bertingkat

Teluk Intan dan jalan-jalan sambungannya, iaitu suatu jarak

sepanjang 18.08 kilometer; dan

(b) bahagian jalan yang dikenali sebagai Lebuh Raya Pesisiran

Pantai Barat (Taiping-Banting) yang bermula dari

kilometer 193.59 di koordinat U 455672.836, T 310764.161

Grid Bentuk Benar Serong di Tepi (RSO) Geosentrik

(GDM 2000) dan berakhir di kilometer 241.63 di koordinat

U 498349.253, T 311975.628 Grid RSO Geosentrik

(GDM 2000) (kedua-dua jarak diukur dari

kilometer 0.0 Lebuh Raya Pesisiran Pantai Barat

(Taiping-Banting) di Persimpangan Bertingkat Banting)

termasuk Persimpangan Bertingkat Kg. Lekir, Plaza Tol

Masuk/Keluar Kg. Lekir, Persimpangan Bertingkat Sitiawan,

Plaza Tol Masuk/Keluar Sitiawan, Persimpangan Bertingkat

Sitiawan Utara, Plaza Tol Masuk/Keluar Sitiawan Utara,

Persimpangan Bertingkat Changkat Chermin, Plaza Tol

Masuk/Keluar Changkat Chermin, Persimpangan Bertingkat

Beruas, Plaza Tol Masuk/Keluar Beruas dan jalan-jalan

sambungannya, iaitu suatu jarak sepanjang

48.04 kilometer.".

(b) dalam teks bahasa Inggeris, dengan menggantikan subperenggan (2)

dengan subperenggan yang berikut:

"(2) The roads declared to be Federal roads under

subparagraph (1) are shown on the map in the Schedule.".

FEDERAL ROADS ACT 1959

FEDERAL ROADS (WEST COAST EXPRESSWAY (TAIPING-BANTING))

(AMENDMENT) ORDER 2019

IN exercise of the powers conferred by section 3 of the Federal Roads Act 1959 [Act 376],

the Minister, after consultation with the State Government of Perak, makes the

following order:

Citation and commencement

1. (1) This order may be cited as the Federal Roads (West Coast Expressway

(Taiping-Banting)) (Amendment) Order 2019.

(2) This Order comes into operation on 23 September 2019.

Amendment of paragraph 2

2. The Federal Roads (West Coast Expressway (Taiping-Banting)) Order 2019

[P.U. (A) 150/2019], which is referred to as the "principal Order" in this Order, is amended

in paragraph 2—

(a) by substituting for subparagraph (1) the following subparagraph:

"(1) The following parts of the roads are declared to be Federal roads:

 (a) the part of the road known as the West Coast Expressway

(Taiping–Banting) commencing from kilometre 143.99 at

coordinates N 421777.709, E 333667.462 of the Rectified

Skew Orthomorphic (RSO) Geocentric (GDM 2000) Grid and

ending at kilometre 162.07 at coordinates N 438818.638,

E 331585.659 of the RSO Geocentric (GDM 2000) Grid

(both distances are measured from kilometre 0.0 of the

West Coast Expressway (Taiping–Banting) at the Banting

Interchange) including the Hutan Melintang Interchange,

Hutan Melintang Entry/Exit Toll Plaza, Teluk Intan

Entry/Exit Toll Plaza, Teluk Intan Interchange and its link

roads, being a distance of 18.08 kilometre; and

(b) the part of the road known as the West Coast Expressway

(Taiping-Banting) commencing from kilometre 193.59 at

coordinates N 455672.836, E 310764.161 of the Rectified

Skew Orthomorphic (RSO) Geocentric (GDM 2000) Grid and

ending at kilometre 241.63 at coordinates N 498349.253,

E 311975.628 of the RSO Geocentric (GDM 2000) Grid

(both distances are measured from kilometre 0.0 of the

West Coast Expressway (Taiping-Banting) at the Banting

Interchange) including the Kg. Lekir Interchange, Kg. Lekir

Entry/Exit Toll Plaza, Sitiawan Interchange, Sitiawan

Entry/Exit Toll Plaza, Sitiawan North Interchange, Sitiawan

North Entry/Exit Toll Plaza, Changkat Chermin Interchange,

Changkat Chermin Entry/Exit Toll Plaza, Beruas

Interchange, Beruas Entry/Exit Toll Plaza and its link roads,

being a distance of 48.04 kilometre.".

 (b) in the English text, by substituting for subparagraph (2) the following

subparagraph:

"(2) The roads declared to be Federal roads under subparagraph (1) are

shown on the map in the Schedule.".

Substitution of Schedule

3. The principal Order is amended by substituting for the Schedule the

following Schedule:
